protocol.timing: Outer call includes rescue work and final CPU verification, excludes setup/loading/output serialization/validation. GPU command time overlaps wall.
protocol.cold: Constructor+first includes no cache purge; source_size isolates full-image setup from supplied-seed warm computation.
protocol.memory: Peak RSS captured before validation. Owned buffer snapshots are retained capacities, not allocation-event peaks; GPU shared memory overlaps RSS.
protocol.local_accuracy: Identifiable fixtures: CPU NCC>=.8 and <=.5px/.5degree/1% scale; original thresholds unchanged.
protocol.full_accuracy: Live unchanged CPU coarse search; 6/12 truth objects <=2px/1degree/2%; Src7 compares detections, has no calibrated truth.
protocol.challenges: Random negatives require no scores>=.8; periodic high-score wrong peaks report truth diagnostically and limit claims, not policy training.
protocol.independent_split: 24 new textures/truths/offsets with RNG2026101307, frozen recipe before policy testing. No truth used by rescue.
protocol.verification: All first/repeated outputs checked against frozen CPU, original seed bounds and monotonicity. Float64 oracle allN<=16 or first/middle/last.
